title: Single-cell and spatial transcriptome analyses unveil that MYH11 links stemness to immunotherapy resistance in non-small cell lung cancer.
authors: Xie, Yujie; Xue, Yinyin; Lai, Dongmei; Zhang, Xiang; Li, Guosheng; Zhou, Qinghua
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞和空间转录组分析肺癌干细胞亚群与免疫治疗耐药，虽涉及转录因子预测，但核心是肿瘤转录组和实验验证，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Immunotherapy is an essential treatment strategy for lung cancer, yet resistance to it is often unavoidable, resulting in treatment failure and poor prognosis. The cancer stem cell (CSC) theory offers a valuable perspective for understanding tumor metastasis and resistance to immunotherapy. However, there is a scarcity of multi-omics studies that identify tumor stemness subpopulations and their associated signaling pathways. In this study, we combined single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) with spatial transcriptomics sequencing (ST-seq) to identify a myosin heavy chain 11 (MYH11)-high stemness subpopulation linked to immunotherapy resistance. METHODS: We conducted quality control and removed batch effects from two scRNA-seq datasets, then annotated cell types using established marker genes. Malignant cells were distinguished from epithelial cells with fastCNV. Stemness subpopulations were identified using a machine learning-derived messenger RNA (mRNA) stemness index (mRNAsi) and CytoTRACE analysis. To functionally characterize the stemness subpopulation, we employed Monocle3 pseudotime trajectory analysis, CellChat cell-cell communication analysis, and predicted transcription factors (TFs). We also performed consensus clustering on bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) data, followed by immune-related scoring, immune cell deconvolution, and drug sensitivity prediction. Clinical validation was achieved through multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) and immunohistochemistry (IHC). Experimental validation included short hairpin RNA (shRNA)-mediated MYH11 knockdown, real-time quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR) and western blot analyses, and tumor sphere formation assays to assess cancer stemness. RESULTS: We identified nine major cell types and found a significant enrichment of epithelial cells in tumors resistant to immunotherapy. Using fastCNV, we identified malignant cells and defined seven malignant cell subtypes based on stemness scoring. Notably, the Stem-subtype was significantly enriched in resistant tumors. Functional analysis showed that the Stem-subtype could differentiate into other malignant cell subtypes, with a strong enrichment in the NOTCH signaling pathway. Analysis of fibroblast subpopulations revealed that MYH11 (+) fibroblasts were closely linked to the Stem-subtype, collectively contributing to immunotherapy resistance. Consensus clustering identified two stemness-related subtypes, with Stemness I associated with poor prognosis. Immune scoring and immune cell analysis further indicated an unfavorable response to immunotherapy in Stemness I. Drug sensitivity prediction identified potential therapeutic agents, and in silico knockout experiments revealed downstream target genes. Validation with clinical samples confirmed that MYH11-high cancer cells were closely correlated with exhausted CD8(+) T cell infiltration and poor immunotherapy outcomes. Experimental validation demonstrated that MYH11 knockdown significantly reduced the expression levels of CXCL12 and TUBA1A, as well as the expression of core NOTCH pathway genes. Furthermore, the tumor sphere-forming capacity was markedly suppressed. CONCLUSIONS: In summary, our multi-omics analysis revealed a MYH11-high malignant cell stemness subpopulation and a MYH11 (+) fibroblast subpopulation, both of which are closely linked to immunotherapy resistance and poor prognosis in lung cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：免疫治疗是肺癌的重要治疗策略，然而对其耐药性往往不可避免，导致治疗失败和预后不良。癌症干细胞（CSC）理论为理解肿瘤转移和免疫治疗耐药提供了有价值的视角。然而，识别肿瘤干性亚群及其相关信号通路的多组学研究仍较为缺乏。在本研究中，我们结合单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）和空间转录组测序（ST-seq），识别出一个与免疫治疗耐药相关的高表达肌球蛋白重链11（MYH11）的干性亚群。方法：我们对两个scRNA-seq数据集进行了质量控制和批次效应去除，然后使用已建立的标记基因注释细胞类型。通过fastCNV区分恶性细胞与上皮细胞。使用机器学习衍生的信使RNA（mRNA）干性指数（mRNAsi）和CytoTRACE分析识别干性亚群。为功能表征干性亚群，我们采用了Monocle3伪时间轨迹分析、CellChat细胞间通讯分析，并预测了转录因子（TFs）。我们还对批量RNA测序（RNA-seq）数据进行了共识聚类，随后进行免疫相关评分、免疫细胞去卷积和药物敏感性预测。临床验证通过多重免疫荧光（mIF）和免疫组化（IHC）实现。实验验证包括短发夹RNA（shRNA）介导的MYH11敲低、实时定量逆转录PCR（qRT-PCR）和蛋白质印迹分析，以及肿瘤球形成实验以评估癌症干性。结果：我们识别出九种主要细胞类型，并发现免疫治疗耐药肿瘤中上皮细胞显著富集。使用fastCNV，我们识别了恶性细胞，并基于干性评分定义了七种恶性细胞亚型。值得注意的是，Stem亚型在耐药肿瘤中显著富集。功能分析显示，Stem亚型可分化成其他恶性细胞亚型，并在NOTCH信号通路中显著富集。成纤维细胞亚群分析显示，MYH11（+）成纤维细胞与Stem亚型密切相关，共同促进免疫治疗耐药。共识聚类识别出两种干性相关亚型，其中Stemness I与不良预后相关。免疫评分和免疫细胞分析进一步表明Stemness I对免疫治疗反应不佳。药物敏感性预测识别出潜在治疗药物，计算机模拟敲除实验揭示了下游靶基因。临床样本验证证实，高表达MYH11的癌细胞与耗竭性CD8（+）T细胞浸润和不良免疫治疗结果密切相关。实验验证表明，MYH11敲低显著降低了CXCL12和TUBA1A的表达水平，以及NOTCH通路核心基因的表达。此外，肿瘤球形成能力显著受到抑制。结论：总之，我们的多组学分析揭示了一个高表达MYH11的恶性细胞干性亚群和一个MYH11（+）成纤维细胞亚群，两者均与肺癌免疫治疗耐药和不良预后密切相关。
